subject: Capturing chunks as both comments and as R instructions

messages.author: 3b0940ce7a895cd1
messages.subject: Capturing chunks as both comments and as R instructions
parts:
I'd like to be able to have a chunk of R code do two things at once:

1) generate the requested output (as usual)

2) capture the chunk's r code and push the R code as a "comment" (or marginalia of some sort or another) into the output document. Ideally this would allow allow one to view the code only if desired, but if the code was put to the margin (ala Tufte) that might be a nice way to handle it too.

I suspect that the implementation may be document-type specific (HTML, .vs. PDF, .vs. ?) but I'll raise the qusetion and see what comments it brings.

Thanks for a spectacular package!

R

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Capturing chunks as both comments and as R instructions
parts:
You can use the same chunk label
(http://yihui.name/knitr/demo/reference/) but with eval=FALSE, e.g

A code chunk here:

<<foo, echo = FALSE>>=
1+1
@

The source code was

<<foo, eval = FALSE>>=
@

If you want the code to be commented out, that is a different story.
You are right that it is document-type specific, although it is also
possible.

Regards,
Yihui
